name: Ignite the Depths
description:
About This Game

Ignite the Depths is a cooperative, fast-paced dark fantasy dungeon crawler with NO forced PvP or extraction mechanics. In your quest for mythical riches, descend into the Abyss alone or with a party of treasure hunters to slay terrifying monsters lurking within maze-like dungeons

CHOOSE YOUR CLASS

Master four distinct classes, each with unique abilities, weapons, and team roles. Whether you prefer to rain down a barrage of fireballs from afar, unleash a fury of your blade, or hold the frontline behind your shield, the choice is yours.

Throughout your adventure, you will mold your character into a unique build that suits your playstyle. New classes will join the adventure as development continues.

A HAND-CRAFTED DARK FANTASY WORLD TO DISCOVER

Explore a wide variety of dreamlike vistas while cutting through relentless foes. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover secret pathways filled with danger and treasure, parkour across ancient ruins, and hack and slash your way deeper into the haunting beauty of the Abyss.

Each dimension is guarded by a powerful Lord, promising a fierce battle and a worthy reward.

DESCENT INTO THE ABYSS TOGETHER

While every hero is fully playable solo, each class is designed with deep co-op synergy, rewarding creative teamwork and combinations of abilities.

Coordinate your powers and chain their effects into devastating combinations. Experiment with different party compositions and discover new strategies as your builds evolve.

UNLEASH YOUR ULTIMATE POWER

Slay enemies, annihilate every barrel in sight, and hunt down hidden treasures to mold your character exactly how you want and grow into a force of incredible power.

Level up seven distinct skills and purchase randomized, game-altering buffs from Pickle and Po’s shop. These two extremely trustworthy merchants are always ready to make you an offer.

The treasures gleam in the darkness, waiting to be claimed. Do you have what it takes to conquer the Abyss?
short_desc: Ignite the Depths is an atmospheric dark-fantasy PvE dungeon crawler set within a sprawling, hand-crafted labyrinth. Descend into the darkness alone or unite with up to 4 players in a co-op adventure. Will you conquer the Abyss?
